aria.toggleRightPanel: Collapse or expand the parameter panel
aria.resizeRightPanel: Drag to resize the parameter panel

sidebar.deleteBody: This will permanently delete the conversation and all its messages. This cannot be undone.

chat.noModelsHint: Add a provider and enable models in Settings first

noProvider.title: Welcome to Easy WebUI
noProvider.desc: A local-first multi-provider LLM chat client. Add a model provider to start chatting.

noConversation.title: Start a new conversation
noConversation.desc: Pick a model and type a message to begin. Markdown, code highlighting and streaming are supported.

input.placeholder: Type a message… (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for newline)
input.placeholderNoModel: Select a model from the top bar first

cause.auth: The API key is invalid, expired, or lacks permission.
cause.rate: Rate limited by the provider, or quota exhausted.
cause.server: The provider's server returned an error.
cause.network: The provider is unreachable, or the base URL is misconfigured.
cause.timeout: The request timed out; the provider responded too slowly.
cause.config: The conversation has no valid provider/model, or the provider has no API key.

advice.auth: Check and update the API key in Settings → Providers.
advice.rate: Retry later, or check the provider's quota and rate-limit policy.
advice.server: Retry later; if it persists, check the provider's status page.
advice.network: Check your network connection and the provider's base URL.
advice.timeout: Retry later; the stream idle timeout was already retried once automatically.
advice.config: Select a model in the top bar, or fill in the API key in Settings.
advice.unknown: Retry; if it keeps failing, check the provider configuration.

params.title: Session parameters

preset.deleteBody: This will permanently delete the preset “{{name}}”. Conversations referencing it will fall back to the global preset. This cannot be undone.

params.systemPromptPlaceholder: Leave empty to skip injecting a system prompt
params.stopStringsHint: Comma-separated. Generation stops when any string is produced. Empty = not sent.
params.repeatPenaltyHint: Applies when checked. Mapped to frequency_penalty (value − 1, only sent when > 1) on OpenAI-compatible APIs; OpenRouter also receives repetition_penalty at face value; ignored on Anthropic.
params.structuredHint: Constrain output with a JSON Schema (OpenAI response_format / Responses text.format, strict mode; an unparseable schema errors out before sending). Ignored on Anthropic.

presets.desc: The global preset is the parameter baseline for every conversation: a conversation inherits the global preset plus its selected user preset, then applies its own overrides. User presets are managed in the Preset block of the chat parameter panel.
presets.resetBody: All parameters of the global preset will be reset to factory values. Saved per-conversation overrides are not affected. This cannot be undone.

providers.emptyHint: Click “Add provider” and start from one of the 12 presets.
providers.deleteBody: The {{count}} conversation(s) of this provider will be kept, but you will need to re-assign a model to them. This cannot be undone.
providers.manualPlaceholder: Type a model ID and press Enter
providers.detectFailed: Could not auto-detect; please choose manually
providers.fetchFailed: Failed to fetch the model list

general.autoTitleHint: Summarize a title automatically after the first turn
general.titleModelHint: When unset, each conversation's own model is used to generate its title
general.titleModelHintPinned: All conversation titles will be generated with this model
general.titleModelClear: Clear and fall back to each conversation's model
general.titleModelEmpty: No models available yet — add a provider and enable models in Providers first
general.enterSendHint: When off, Enter inserts a newline and Ctrl/Cmd+Enter sends
general.zoomHint: 50% – 250% in 10% steps, applies instantly; default browser/Electron zoom gestures are disabled
general.fontUiHint: Font stack (e.g. "SF Pro Text", sans-serif); leave empty for the default stack
general.fontCodeHint: Applies to code blocks, inline code and monospaced inputs; empty = default
general.fontUiSizeHint: Integer, 10 – 24 px; empty = default 16px, applies instantly
general.fontCodeSizeHint: Integer, 6 – 40 px; applies to code blocks and inline code; empty = default
general.fontSizeInvalid: Font size must be an integer between {{min}} and {{max}} px
general.codeThemeHint: Auto follows the page light/dark theme
general.dataPathChangeElectronOnly: Changing the data location is only available in the desktop app
general.dataPathConfirmBody: All current data (conversations, providers, presets, backups) will be migrated to the new directory; a restart is required to take effect.
general.dataPathConfirmAdopt: The selected directory already contains Easy WebUI data. The app will switch to it directly (current data is NOT copied) after a restart.
general.dataPathInvalid: Directory unavailable: choose a writable directory that is not the current data directory or inside it
general.dataPathFailed: Failed to change the data location
general.dataPathDoneBody: Data location changed to: {{path}}. It takes effect after restarting the app.
general.encWeakWarn: System-level encryption is unavailable on this system; API keys are stored with weak protection. Avoid storing high-value keys on this machine.

backup.includeKeys: Include API keys (encrypted with a password)
backup.includeKeysHint: Without keys, you will need to re-enter API keys after restoring.
backup.passwordTooShort: Password must be at least 8 characters
backup.emptyHint: Click “Create backup” to make your first one.
backup.deleteBody: This will delete the backup file “{{name}}”. This cannot be undone.
backup.passwordNeeded: If the backup includes keys, enter its password; otherwise leave empty.
backup.overwriteConfirmBody: Overwrite mode wipes existing providers, conversations and messages (a temporary backup is made automatically first), then imports the backup. Continue?
backup.resultBody: Imported {{providers}} providers, {{conversations}} conversations, {{messages}} messages, {{presets}} presets; skipped {{skipped}} existing records.

about.appTagline: A local-first multi-provider LLM chat client
about.author: Author
about.updateElectronOnly: Online updates are only available in the desktop (Electron) app
about.autoUpdateHint: Automatically check for new versions at startup
about.updateFailedToast: Update check failed — please try again later
about.updateNotConfiguredToast: Update source not configured yet (project not published)
about.downloadFailedToast: Update download or verification failed — please retry
about.backupWarning: Back up your data to a safe location before installing the new version (Settings → Backup).
about.installConfirmBody: The app will close, install {{version}}, and restart automatically. Make sure important data is backed up.
about.installUnsupported: No update installer is configured for this environment

toast.truncated: A message exceeded the context budget and was truncated before sending
toast.generationInProgress: A generation is already in progress for this conversation
toast.noProvider: No provider yet — add one in Settings first
toast.noModel: Select a model from the top bar first
toast.contextOverflow: Context over budget: ~{{tokens}} tokens estimated, exceeding the {{budget}}-token budget. Enable “Truncate middle”, clear history, or switch to a model with a longer context
toast.titleFailedAuto: Auto title generation failed (already retried once). The network or provider may be temporarily unavailable. Your conversation is unaffected; retry via the ✨ button next to the rename field.
toast.titleNoModel: No model available for title generation: no title model is set in Settings and this conversation has no model. Set one in Settings → General, or pick a model for the conversation first.
toast.titleNoUserMessage: This conversation has no messages yet, so there is nothing to summarize. Send a message first.
toast.titleFailed: Title generation failed (already retried once). The network or provider may be temporarily unavailable. Click ✨ again later to retry.
toast.fontRejected: Font not applied: the input contains disallowed characters. Font stacks only allow letters, digits, spaces, commas, quotes, hyphens and dots. Fix the input, or leave it empty to restore the default font.
